title: kookr-evolution-config.v1
description: Project-supplied manifest declaring how an autonomous evolution run evaluates trials. Lives at `.kookr/evolution/config.json` in the target repo. Kookr reads only this manifest and the trial-result JSON the declared commands emit; all domain logic stays in the project's scripts. See docs/rfc/issue-1061-autonomous-evolution-playbook/RFC.md.

schemaVersion.description: Schema discriminator. Always the literal version string.

evaluate.description: Required. Command (relative to `.kookr/evolution/`) that evaluates the current trial artifact and writes a kookr-evolution-trial.v1 JSON to the path Kookr provides via $KOOKR_EVOLUTION_TRIAL_OUT. Exits non-zero ONLY on evaluation failure, never on a poor score.

propose.description: Optional. Command that produces the next challenger by mutating the artifact in the trial workspace. When absent, the agent proposes the mutation itself.

apply.description: Optional. Command that installs a promoted champion back into the project (e.g. commits or copies the winning artifact). When absent, the agent applies the promotion.

artifact.description: Required. Opaque path (relative to the project root) of the artifact under evolution. Kookr mutates a copy in the trial workspace and never parses its contents.

higherIsBetter.description: Optimization direction for the trial `score`. Source of truth for the run.

targetScore.description: Optional project stop threshold. When the champion score crosses this (honoring `higherIsBetter`), the run stops with reason `target_reached`.

patience.description: Optional plateau window. When this many consecutive EVALUATED trials produce no promotion, the run stops with reason `plateau`. Omit to disable plateau stopping.

minImprovementDelta.description: Minimum score gain (in the better direction) required to count as a promotion. Guards against churn on negligible improvements.

maxConsecutiveFailedTrials.description: Mandatory failure backstop. After this many consecutive FAILED trials (evaluation could not score), the run stops with reason `failure_budget_exhausted`.

deadlineAt.description: Optional wall-clock budget. When the current time is at or past this ISO-8601 timestamp, the run stops with reason `budget_exhausted`. Usually supplied at launch rather than committed.

maxTrials.description: Optional trial-count budget. When the trial log reaches this length, the run stops with reason `budget_exhausted`. Defaults to the Ralph iteration cap when omitted.
